server_id.description: Unique server identifier for replication. Must be unique across all servers in the replication topology.

log_bin_enabled.description: Enable binary logging. Required for replication and point-in-time recovery.

basedir.description: Base directory where MariaDB is installed.

datadir.description: Directory where database files are stored.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files created by MariaDB (e.g., during sorting or temp tables).

bind_address.description: IP address MariaDB binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to accept connections from any interface (not recommended without firewall).

port.description: TCP/IP port number for client connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any generated/intermediate BLOB.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of the memory buffer InnoDB uses to cache data and indexes. Recommend ~70% of available RAM on dedicated servers.

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger values improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls InnoDB durability vs performance trade-off. 1 = safest (sync on each commit), 2 = faster (sync once/sec), 0 = fastest (risk of data loss).

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file. Required for tablespace operations and compression.

query_cache_type.description: Query cache behavior: 0=OFF, 1=ON (cache all except SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE), 2=DEMAND (cache only SELECT SQL_CACHE). Deprecated in MariaDB 10.1+.

query_cache_size.description: Total memory allocated for query cache. Set to 0 to disable. Ignored if query_cache_type is OFF.

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep cached for reuse. Helps reduce thread creation overhead on high-concurrency workloads.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for new databases and tables.

collation_server.description: Default collation for new databases and tables. Must match character_set_server.

slow_query_log_enabled.description: Enable logging of slow queries to file (or to table if log_output includes TABLE).

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file (only used if slow_query_log is enabled).

long_query_time.description: Queries taking longer than this many seconds will be logged as slow queries.
